item.title: APAD RK2808: Notes on Getting Root, and Mounting an NFS Network Drive
item.description:
See: Getting root on the RK2808 System disk image, plus material on other custom firmware builds

A basic tutorial for modifying Rockchip RK28XX Android system firmware images

It was a real pain. I did it many times, and I found that tutorials exist but none of them are complete — miss one step and you may end up without root.

Preparation:

A flashing tool. Download link: flashing tool

A ROM. There are lots of versions, some stock, some modified. I used a modified one, hybrid 5.1, downloaded from a foreign forum — hybrid 5.1. Note that this ROM claims to have root enabled, but in fact it does not. You can join the QQ group, the shared files are in there: 83895562
